dataset.name: ERP CORE
dataset.discovery: Locate recording and event files by walking the BIDS directory. Work out which event codes form each condition from the dataset documentation in that directory.

channels.note: These three EOG channels are read as type EEG from the .set files. Remove them first; the 30 remaining scalp channels are analysed.

filter.h_trans_bandwidth: MNE default rule: a quarter of the upper cutoff and at least 2 Hz

analysis.reference: average of the 30 scalp channels, applied directly (projection False)

events.source: the BIDS events.tsv of the recording

contrast.plus: unrelated (target word of an unrelated word pair)
contrast.minus: related (target word of a related word pair)
contrast.difference: mean of plus trials minus mean of minus trials

analysis.minimum_trials_rule: A subject with fewer retained trials than this in either condition is ineligible.
analysis.amplitude: mean over the ROI channels and window samples of the difference wave, in microvolts

derivatives.requirement: A BIDS-Derivatives dataset that passes the BIDS validator with no errors and holds the ERP result of every analysed subject under its sub-XXX folder. The validator is not installed in this environment.

required_results.status: computed, or ineligible for a subject below the trial minimum
required_results.dataset_version: dataset version as stated in the dataset's own CHANGES file
required_results.subject: subject label
required_results.roi_amplitude_uv: ROI amplitude in microvolts, full precision

required_evidence.times_s: all epoch sample times in seconds, whole epoch
required_evidence.roi_difference_uv: difference wave averaged over the ROI, microvolts, one value per epoch sample, whole epoch
